note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py), dual mode (experiment): public constants only; the hidden episode is episode.json, which only the worker reads. sim_dir is the grader's own simulator, which setup.sh copies (root-only) from the image's /opt/labbench-commission (the commissioning service's byte copies of tests/lab_sim.py, lab_env.py, box_transport_env.py, lab_render.py and lab_look.json) together with online/episode.py (a byte copy of tests/episode.py, the episode's end rules and credit), before any other account runs; sim_sha256 pins every file (the worker refuses to start on a difference). env is the grader's numerics and rendering environment (the images' numerics pin and tests/test.sh's). prep_s is the agent's budget on main ([agent] timeout_sec 7200): the episode must be started within it; graded_s is the window from the start to the episode's latest end. practice_flag (O13): the graded start writes it, and the commissioning service ends its open bench and refuses every request once it exists. The freeze (DM3): at the graded start, or when prep_s runs out without one, the root supervisor copies submission_dir into record_dir/snapshot_name (no link followed; only regular files and folders of the agent's account; main's caps: snapshot_max_files 5000 entries that are not folders and snapshot_max_bytes 200 MiB, counted as the offline grader's stage_submission counts them; the engine's depth limit; over any: snapshot_status too_large and no copy).
